messages:
Sam: Heads up — putting a short proposal on the table: add an X-Embed-Estimate header / server estimator so we can surface a stable \"units\" metric for mixed-dim embeddings payloads. Link to rough draft: https://go/redwood/embed-units (WIP)
Lina: TL;DR?
Sam: TL;DR: current byte-based heuristics are misleading for many customers with mixed-dim vectors. Server computes an estimate (units) = alpha * total_vectors + beta * sum(dims) + overhead, returns it in response headers and telemetry. We surface it in Console and use it for nicer UX (better 413 error messages, dashboarding, and quota guidance).
Ajay: main worry: SDKs that auto-split will generate multiple requests — how do we avoid double-counting or confusing the UI when a single client action becomes N requests?
Marta: Ops perspective: we'd like per-route & per-tenant histograms of units and a retry/split metric. Also want sampling for payloads so we don't ingest vectors. Telemetry should carry dims and counts only.
Sam: rollout thought: start with a non-blocking opt-in phase. Server always computes estimate, but we only show the header for tenants in the canary. No hard quota change initially — just telemetry & console surface. After 2 weeks, enable advisory fastfail for opt-in SDK versions.
Ajay: backcompat: clients not opting in still get legacy byte rules. If server computes units anyway, can we attach header even when client doesn't ask? That helps Console. But for SDK fastfail we should require an opt-in header to avoid surprising behavior.
Lina: UX for errors: return 413 with structured details (short, non-PII): e.g. `{"reason":"units_exceeded","estimate":"120u","limit":"100u","suggestion":"try smaller batch or upgrade plan"}`. Console will map u->estimated cost.
Ajay: SDK changes: propose SDK add `headers['X-Embed-Estimate'] = '1'` for opt-in and expose `response.headers['X-Embed-Units']`. SDK should also add an idempotency-ish request id when it splits to let Console aggregate.
Sam: example snippet for SDK opt-in:
```
// python SDK pseudo
client.extra_headers['X-Embed-Estimate'] = 'true'
resp = client.embeddings(payload)
print(resp.headers.get('X-Embed-Units'))
```
Marta: telemetry note: DO NOT send vectors/text in logs. Send only `{counts, dims_histogram, total_vectors, estimated_units}` with sampling flag. Mask tenant ids in raw traces.
ConsoleBot: deploy-schedule-bot: canary rollout window planned starting 1749990000 for 10% of prod tenants, will run 14 days.
Lina: Console needs two new cards: median units per request (by route), 95th/99th and split-retry %; have a tiny tooltip explaining mapping to dollars and recommended thresholds.
Ajay: how do we map units -> quota buckets? Current quota is token/byte-based. We need a deterministic mapping (units -> billing units). That suggests a migration plan: shadow-units accounting for 2 billing cycles, then opt-in.
Marta: Alerts: add `split_retry_rate > 5%` per tenant over 5m and `units_estimate > 5x median` for the route as early warning. Also mark top contributors so SEs can reach out.
Sam: I'll open the estimator PR (runtime): compute cheap estimate at ingress, attach `X-Embed-Units` and `X-Embed-Estimate=calculated`. Will add a feature flag to gate header emission.
Ajay: I'll add SDK PR to opt-in and add a `split_group_id` header to let Console glue split requests together for UX. Also add unit-test matrix for mixed-dim arrays.
Lina: +1. Please include integration test that verifies console aggregation of split requests (we currently surface separate rows).
Marta: ops will prototype the telemetry pipeline change: a lightweight kafka topic with aggregated unit metrics (no payload). We'll do a retention of 30d for histograms.
Sam: Can we also add a tiny bounce-back message for users: if estimate > limit return `413` with `Retry-After` suggestion and a one-liner explaining split tradeoffs.
Ajay: question: rate limiter — does it still count by tokens/bytes? We need to decide whether limits map to units (preferred) or stay byte-based. Mapping function must be conservative.
Lina: product note: we should include a console toggle for customers to opt into units-based accounting early. Visibility helps adoption.
Marta: ops will prepare runbook for increased split-induced traffic. If split retries spike after rollout, we roll back header emission and open a P0.
Sam: I'll draft the rollout plan and PR checklist. Target to have runtime + telemetry PRs out by EOW. Ajay, can you review SDK changes next week?
Ajay: yea, will review and run integration tests.
Lina: also add a short blurb in API docs: how `X-Embed-Estimate` works and what `X-Embed-Units` means for billing/console. Keep it non-normative until billing agrees.
Marta: ack. Ops will monitor the canary.
Sam: thanks all — filing the proposal and a small follow-up RFC with concrete formulas.
Lina: thanks — excited to see clearer metrics for customers.
Ajay: noted.
Marta: 👍
ConsoleBot: note: created canary ticket #CAN-5123
Sam: closing thread, will ping when PRs are up.
